title: How to start?
author: Lost_Suggestion_2436
selftext: I know very basic coding from trying to mod terraria and making my own games but I am not good, I am hoping this can help me actually make something or at least have a template I can edit into something else and make my own sprites. Any basic pointers?

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
What are you asking? What do you want? I read it three times.

Do you want to make game assets? Do you want to make an indie game?

replies.author: Lost_Suggestion_2436
replies.body:
I can make art, yes its an indie game because its just me.
I was looking for something like terraria as a template and if I could use ai to help me code items and bosses.

Or if I could use terraria as the template but the game updates and all the ai code is outdated/dosent work.

I'm looking for any pointers at all as to how to start using ai.

Your response comes off as rude tbh and didn't offer anything

comments.author: constroyr
comments.body: For me, it's been important to find projects that are small enough in scope that I can finish them in a matter of weeks, but interesting enough that it keeps me engaged. Anything I struggle with, I ask ChatGPT. In this area, I've found GPT4.5 much more helpful than 3.5. If its advice doesn't work, then I ask if again, specifying the issue with its previous suggestion. If it still can't figure it out, I just Google it.

comments.author: qeadwrsf
comments.body:
pick a language. 

Learn how to use: 

strings, int, float, functions, array, lists, dicts, classes, class methods, references, importing libraries, use libraries. 

pick a game engine. 

Watch youtube, learn, program?

Solve errors until you know what you're doing. 

Solve problems down the road with AI. Post here about it.

comments.author: Inevitable_Force_397
comments.body: There are videos on youtube that walk you through the process of using Unity or Unreal as a beginner. There are templates like you describe that exist for free, and if you do a search on youtube or google, you'll likely come across some of these tutorials pretty quickly.

replies.author: Lost_Suggestion_2436
replies.body: Those templates I've found are not good thats why I am asking people but nobody told me anything other than Google it or learn stuff
